keySource: The key is NYSED's own, read from the Map to the Standards in the released-items PDF and carried into provenance/itemmap_g6-2025.json by tools/extract_item_map.py. tools/merge_content.py re-checks every letter against that file item by item and refuses to build if one disagrees, so the key here cannot drift from the official table or be shifted by one released item. Every constructed-response answer below cites NYSED's own exemplary-response page and is checked against this project's transcription of the same item.

37.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 7 (PDF page 8)
37.check: 6 students are 24% of the class, and 6 over 0.24 is 25. Both figures are in this item's own transcribed stem.

38.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 12 (PDF page 13)

39.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 17 (PDF page 18)
39.check: 72 is 24 times 3 and 96 is 24 times 4. Both numbers are in this item's own transcribed stem.

40.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 22 (PDF page 23)
40.check: 5 squared is 25, plus 3 is 28, times 4 is 112, less 6 is 106. The expression is this item's own transcribed stem, and it depends on the exponent being read.

41.answer: t = 56b; t is the dependent variable and b the independent one
41.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 32 (PDF page 33)
41.check: Every row of the table divides to 56: 112 over 2, 224 over 4, 336 over 6, 448 over 8. The table is this item's figure.

42.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 42 (PDF page 43)
42.check: The square base is 5 by 5, which is 25, and the four triangles are each a half of 5 by 3.5, which is 35 in total. Both dimensions are in this item's figure.

43.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 52 (PDF page 53)
43.check: Twenty-one and two thirds divided by three and a third is 65/3 times 3/10, which is six and a half. Both quantities are in this item's own transcribed stem.

44.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 62 (PDF page 63)
44.check: The cabbage is at 5, negative 3 and the broccoli at negative 2, negative 3, so they are 5 plus 2 apart. Both points are labelled in this item's figure.

45.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 72 (PDF page 73)
45.check: Two cups of sesame to five of pretzels is 2.5 cups of pretzels per cup of sesame, and 3 times 2.5 is 7.5. Both quantities are in this item's own stem.

46.source: NYSED exemplary response, scoring materials page 82 (PDF page 83)
46.check: 9 times 2x equals 54 gives x = 3; 7p = 784 gives p = 112. The rug's dimensions are in this item's figure and the total is in its stem.
